sharpness: Improve sharpness and keep object boundaries well defined.
exposure: Maintain stable, natural exposure and avoid locally overexposed or underexposed areas.
color_stability: Keep object colors, materials, and lighting consistent across frames.
temporal_flicker: Keep lighting, textures, and detail stable over time without flicker.
motion_smoothness: Keep motion continuous, smooth, and physically plausible; avoid abrupt jumps or jitter.
motion_fidelity: Preserve the reference video motion paths, directions, timing, and action phases exactly.
scene_stability: Remove unintended camera or scene drift while preserving camera motion, entity motion and state changes required by the task and declared reference behavior.
visual_realism: Improve realistic materials, lighting, shadows, and geometry. Remove unnatural textures, distorted parts, and visible generation artifacts.
physical_temporal_coherence: Keep joints, contact relationships, object shapes, and interactions physically plausible and temporally consistent. Avoid floating, penetration, disappearance, or deformation.
task_semantic_consistency: Fulfil the original task with the selected target structure, required entities and relationships, event order and state changes. Correct documented mapping errors without inventing unsupported mechanisms or actions.
abnormal_frames: Avoid black, blank, corrupt, or low-information frames.
preserve: Preserve declared target structure, motion, timing, camera behavior and task-relevant geometry while applying the following evidenced corrections. Do not copy untextured white-model surfaces or invent task content.
